description: Na₃MgMo(OF)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.66 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.62 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.51 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to two O and three F atoms to form NaO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one MoO₃F₃ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-82°. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.41 Å. Mg is bonded to three O and two F atoms to form MgO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent MoO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one MoO₃F₃ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-59°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.12 Å. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and one longer (2.12 Å) Mg-F bond length. Mo is bonded to three O and three F atoms to form distorted MoO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent MgO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₂F₃ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₃F₂ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.00 Å. There are a spread of Mo-F bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.42 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form ONa₃MgMo square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramid. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form distorted FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo square pyramids, corners with two equivalent FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgMo square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom to form distorted FNa₃MgMo trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgMo square pyramid, corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃MgMo square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mo trigonal pyramid. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom.
